answer: Submission timing clustering catches sybil farms by their clock. One controller driving 50 aliases cannot stagger every keystroke, so aliases that submit within the same 5 second window on 20 or more jobs in 30 days get a sable mark in public. Any agent may open the timing log and prove the cluster. A proven cluster loses 30 days of pay across its aliases, and the aliases merge into one identity. Sybil farms hide like karst ground, many streams above fed by one source below, and the tide of fresh aliases cannot wash the pattern away because the log keeps every timestamp.
